dz: 在拜占庭皇帝迈克尔·克·卡拉法特斯试图废黜他妻子并镇压佐伊·波菲罗金塔后,君士坦丁堡爆发了一场民众起义,意图使她复原.
de: Following the attempt of Byzantine Emperor Michael V Kalaphates to depose his wife and empress Zoe Porphyrogenita, a popular uprising in Constantinople breaks out with the intention to restore her.

te: Election of Pope John XIX following the death of his brother Pope Benedict VIII.
dz: 教皇约翰十九世在他的兄弟教皇本笃八世去世后当选。

te: A Byzantine army under Belisarius is defeated by the Persians at Raqqa (northern Syria).
dz: 卡利尼库姆战役:贝利萨里乌斯统治下一支拜占庭军队被波斯人击败于拉卡(叙利亚北部).
de: Battle of Callinicum: A Byzantine army under Belisarius is defeated by the Persians at Raqqa (northern Syria).

te: The freedman Milichus betrays Piso's plot to kill the Emperor Nero and all of the conspirators are arrested.
dz: 自由人米利丘斯背叛了皮索杀死尼禄皇帝的阴谋,所有阴谋者都被逮捕.
